bundle.shortDescription: Organize and manage your Steam library
bundle.longDescription: Steam Vault is a cross-platform Steam library organizer. It reads your local Steam data to categorize, filter, and auto-organize games, and manages non-Steam shortcuts with SteamGridDB artwork.
